temperature_units: Kelvin for surface tension, density and Arrhenius viscosity; Celsius for the electrical resistivity polynomial

locations.Sn60Pb40_resistivity: PDF page 107, printed page 102, Table 5.1; fit 250–1000 C; resistivity in microohm cm
locations.viscosity: PDF page 169, printed page 164, Table 7.1; eta0 in mPa s, Ea in kJ/mol; absolute temperature
locations.Sn60Pb40_surface_density: PDF page 145, reprinted Kaban et al. paper Table 1; absolute temperature

Sn99.3Cu0.7.limitations: Conductivity is a graph-read liquid estimate, density and surface tension are near-tin screening values, not calibrated fits for this exact alloy. Thesis Table 5.1 labels Sn99Cu1 and is not silently substituted for Cu0.7.

limitations: Industrial solder and atmosphere affect properties. Thesis reports about 5% viscosity measurement precision and discusses wider inter-author scatter. No oxide skin/contact-angle calibration follows from these values.
